metadata.name: Laboratory experiment zooplankton and phytoplankton pulsation dataset
metadata.description: Measurements of X. umbellata pulsation (unitless) recorded in twelve experimental tanks (T1‑T12) under different treatments (Zooplankton, Control, DOC, Phytoplankton) at several time points (DOE = 0, 7, 14, 21, 28). The data are from a controlled laboratory experiment.
